requirement: R27 Server owner through composition DAG
decision: STOP - Server cannot move before the Backend extraction. The DAG Server shape has no transport, routes, lifecycle or host options; constructing the current listener/routes requires the host's `StartBridgeServerOptions` object.

evidence.dagServerShape: composition-dag.ts:129-134: ServerShape = { id, backend: {id, artifactStore, eventLog}, providerPermits }. serverLayer (:374-382) only composes those values; it has no listener, request handler, port, close/readiness or shutdown service.
evidence.hostConstruction: index.ts:20507 createBridgeRequestListener(options, createRequestHandler) -> :20624 createServer -> :20643 requestListener -> :20664 listen(server, options.host, options.port) -> :20666-20679 returns {port, close}; shutdown order is server.close only. readiness is a route readback (options.readStartupReadiness) and shutdown is options.shutdown.
evidence.handlerSignature: index.ts:17393 createRequestHandler(options: StartBridgeServerOptions) closes over the host options for every route; :17418 options.host, :17398 options.observabilityScope, :17420 readHealthStatus, :17446 shutdown, :17469 readStartupReadiness, :20298 staticRoot, plus operator/telemetry/learning/queue/benchmark/model/peer routes.
evidence.optionSurface: StartBridgeServerOptions (index.ts:3471-3824) has 183 top-level fields: 5 required (host, port, registry, executeChatCompletions, executeResponses) and 178 optional host callbacks. createRequestHandler references 181 of them; the omitted two are route-agnostic (runtimeChannel and diagnostics are consumed by the listener/health wiring).

blockingFields.note: The optional callbacks are not optional for behaviour parity: each backs an existing route. Injecting a DAG Server without them would make routes 404 or change semantics; fabricating them is a parallel backend.

typeProof.error: TS2345: ServerShape is not assignable to StartBridgeServerOptions; missing host, port, registry, executeChatCompletions, executeResponses
typeProof.note: Only the five REQUIRED fields are named by structural assignability; the 178 optional route callbacks are equally needed for behaviour parity but are not required by the type.

evidence.startStopOrder: Current order: build request listener (module-health composition) -> createServer -> attach trace handlers -> listen (host/port) -> return close. The DAG owns no start/close lifecycle, so moving Server also requires an explicit start/stop owner plus readiness/partial-shutdown ordering. That is beyond a construction move.
evidence.backendBlocker: The DAG BackendShape is only {id, artifactStore, eventLog}; the real backend has the option object and all route capabilities. Backend must be extracted first or expose the complete handler/lifecycle bundle to Server.
